feature_contract.goal: Connect full-resolution native D3D11 per-eye color target binding and original OM/RS restoration to separately posed game-authored Draw/DrawIndexed stereo callbacks, then finish real R30 menu/car/race source replay to OpenXR with input-safe DX9Ex fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Renderer-owned left and right D3D11 draw passes bind the exact generation-owned per-eye RTV, full-target viewport and scissor, and issue native GPU writes without contaminating desktop RT.
Live game D3D9 Present and gamepad/FFB remain authoritative; original D3D11 OM/RS state is restored on completion and failure; stale/partial GPU submissions never reach OpenXR.

Distinct eye GPU outputs pass isolated WARP, exact producer EVENT, snapshot/ACK and five mandatory GitHub Actions checks; real R30 stereo replay, Quest3 visual and performance evidence remain separate.

integration_path: C2 snapshots actual native game D3D11 IA input layout, all 32 bound vertex-stream slots, index buffer/format/offset, topology, and VS/PS shader/class-interface bindings before each real stereo game eye render callback.
Native L/R callback isolation restores source IA/VS/PS before each eye and on all scope exits, retaining existing OM/RS and per-eye RTV/DSV lifetime and producer GPU EVENT/host ACK.

Changed component WARP transport regression mutates input stream/index/topology during each per-eye callback, verifies original state entering both passes and after submission; true R30 menu/car/race stereo replay remains unfinished.
